sloka: गत्वा परममध्वानमुपर्युपरि सागरम्।हिमवन्तं नगश्रेष्ठं हनुमन् गन्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.७४.२९ ।।
transliteration: gatvā paramamadhvānamuparyupari sāgaram।himavantaṁ nagaśreṣṭhaṁ hanuman gantumarhasi ।। 6.74.29 ।।

translations.english: "Hanuman, you ought to go very far over the sea to the Himalayas, the highest mountain."
